title: TodayWeather for iOS · Main tabs
scenario: On the iPhone 16 simulator (iOS 26.5), open each tab with Seoul saved, Korean controls and default text size. The selected icon and label use the theme accent. A short line above them marks the current page.

steps.title: Saved Places
steps.instruction: Tap 즐겨찾기 to see your saved locations.
steps.caption: Saved Places for the saved Seoul location.
steps.expected: The first saved place appears below the search bar.

steps.title: Hourly weather
steps.instruction: Tap 시간별날씨 to see the current temperature and read the hourly forecast below it.
steps.caption: Hourly weather for the saved Seoul location.
steps.expected: The summary leads into the three-hour forecast chart.

steps.title: Daily weather
steps.instruction: Tap 일별날씨 and read the high and low temperatures for each day.
steps.caption: Daily weather for the saved Seoul location.
steps.expected: The daily chart starts below the selected location’s summary.

steps.title: Air quality
steps.instruction: Tap 대기정보 to read the air grade for your selected place.
steps.caption: Air quality for the saved Seoul location.
steps.expected: The air-quality scale appears below the current reading and advice.
